question: At one already frozen Query head, does a full public-anchor replacement remove useful target fusion capability?
scope: Necessary recovery-cost control, not a new defense or Table 6 reproduction
site: block0/head0 Query weight rows 0:64 and matching bias; no Key, Value, output, MLP or LayerNorm edits
selection: Same first head as saved source/Key-contrast audits; fixed before partner measurement
replacement: Public anchor for the entire selected Query support, identically defined for any original or release limited to this support
reason_for_full_replacement: The general per-image score nullspace has an observable affine cleaner, but its useful fusion cost is unknown. A full-support replacement supplies a directly measurable attack on this whole limited family without a large response solve.
calibration: None. No directions, ranks, amplitudes or layers are fitted or scanned
datasets: Full MNIST test 10000; official torchvision DTD partition1 test 1880; fresh matched controls and unchanged partner standalone
precision: FP32, eval mode, TF32 disabled, batch128
AGA: Not run: no protected weights have been constructed. This is a preflight public replacement control
stop: Report complete native and fusion counts and paired prediction changes. If replacement preserves useful target fusion at this fixed site, close Query-only protection here; do not add noise or change head/rank/amplitude. No automatic defense launch even if replacement is costly.
